newsitem.title: USA: Quixote reviews commitment to FIP venture.
newsitem.headline: Quixote reviews commitment to FIP venture.

text.p: Quixote Corp said Monday it is reviewing its commitment to its joint venture to market seismic bridge bearings with FIP Industriale SpA, because of rising costs.

"(W)e are reviewing our level of commitment to the FIP joint venture as expenses have risen to unacceptable levels," Quixote chairman Phillip Rollhaus said in a statement. "In fact, we are vigorously reviewing expenses company-wide to align them with the needs of Quixote today."
Quixote on Monday reported a fiscal third quarter net loss of $1.00 a share versus a net loss of $0.23 a share last year. Earnings from continuing operations were $0.02 a share compared with $0.07.

The company said results of its Energy Absorption Systems Inc were hurt by reduced sales in one product line because of regional competition, increased research and development expenses and rising costs from FIP.
Research and development for the unit rose 42 percent for the quarter and 63 percent year to date, Quixote said, due to new product development and new federal testing guidelines.
The company said it is focused on Energy Aborption Systems, as it sees the unit as Quixote's primary driver of future growth.
